title: eriogonum racemosum var. coccineum
intro: Eriogonum racemosum var. coccineum, commonly known as redflower buckwheat, is a plant species within the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Eriogonum racemosum var. coccineum include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and the potential to reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, but it is thought to contain various phenolic compounds and flavonoids.
